summary.description: One concise sentence describing the isolated subject crop.

genre_or_photography_type.description: Ordered from primary to secondary photographic genre/type, using only visible subject evidence.

species.description: Always present. Biological/taxonomy candidates when a genre entry is wildlife, bird_photography, or plant_botanical; otherwise an empty array. Prefer species-level names when visibly supported; broader taxa are allowed when narrower identification is uncertain.

main_subjects.description: Primary visible subjects in the isolated crop.

secondary_subjects.description: Secondary visible subjects or subject parts in the isolated crop.

behavior_or_action.description: Visible pose, behavior, or action supported by the isolated subject alone.

proposed_keywords.description: Metadata-oriented terms based only on the isolated subject. Exclude exact duplicate species/taxonomy terms, habitat, setting, camera, lens, and software terms.

uncertainty_notes.description: Brief notes about uncertainty, partial visibility, mask/crop issues, or ambiguous identification.

quality_assessment.description: Perceptual quality assessment of the isolated subject only. Keep separate from tags and proposed keywords.

focus.description: Sharpness of the subject's important features. Do not judge original frame placement.

exposure_and_tone.description: Whether subject detail is retained in highlights, shadows, and midtones.

lighting_and_color.description: Whether light and color render the subject clearly and coherently.

detail_and_texture.description: Natural preservation of important texture and fine detail without smearing or excessive sharpening.

pose_expression_or_moment.description: Effectiveness of visible pose, expression, gesture, or behavior. Use unrated when not relevant.

technical_cleanliness.description: Obvious visible noise, halos, compression, oversmoothing, or processing artifacts on the subject. Ignore isolation-edge artifacts unless they obscure detail.

overall_subject_quality.description: Overall quality of the isolated subject only; do not assess composition, background, or scene context.

strengths.description: Up to two concise visible subject strengths. Use an empty array when none are clear.

concerns.description: Up to two concise visible subject weaknesses. Use an empty array when none are clear.

confidence.description: Confidence in the subject-quality assessment as a whole.
Ordinal confidence band. Numeric confidence is intentionally not used.

genre_term.description: Controlled vocabulary for photographic genre or photography type.

evidence.description: Short visible-evidence phrase, not a reasoning trace.

quality_level.description: Use problem for a visible weakness, acceptable for adequate execution, strong when the criterion materially supports the photograph, and unrated when the criterion is not relevant or cannot be judged reliably.

quality_note.description: One concise visible observation, not a reasoning trace or edit instruction.
